# Solstice

Solstice is a IT Services and IT Consulting company. Solstice Advanced Materials delivers high-performance specialty chemicals, semiconductor materials, refrigerants, and industrial solutions for global industries. Solstice employs 205 people (+27.3% YoY, +44 people), founded in 2001. Headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, United States, with offices in 524 Broadway and Buenos Aires. Its workforce is distributed across 6 countries (including United States, Argentina, India, Bermuda, and Indonesia).

## About

Solstice, part of Kin + Carta, is a modern software engineering firm that helps Fortune 500 companies seize new opportunities through world-changing digital solutions. As strategists and consultants, we help organizations evolve their digital strategy to solve mission-critical problems. As designers and developers, we build incredible hardware and software solutions that transcend a standalone product and transform an organization’s relationship with its customers. As instructors and coaches, we help companies transform from the inside out by adopting a high-speed culture of innovation. We’re strategists, researchers, designers, and engineers hell-bent on changing the way the world does business. We’re headquartered in Chicago and have delivery offices in New York, London, and Buenos Aires. 

For more information about Solstice, visit solstice.com

# Solstice

Solstice is a Renewable Energy Semiconductor Manufacturing company. Solstice Community Solar is a company that provides solar energy solutions for businesses and individuals. Solstice employs 32 people (-52.9% YoY) and has an annual revenue of $4M, founded in 2014. Headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Cameroon, United Kingdom, and Vietnam.

## About

Solstice is dedicated to bringing the benefits of clean energy to every community. We connect households and businesses to shared solar farms and high-impact RECs, create financing innovations to expand access to underserved Americans, and provide frictionless subscriber management software for community solar projects.
